source.boundary_method: Withdrawn counted-FC assumption. Live trace evidence is reference/rom_extract/intro/cold_start_observed_dispatch.json.
source.status: byte-exact extraction metadata, but parsed event boundaries are withdrawn
source.withdrawal_reason: FC dispatch reaches $8837 and resumes at the following script byte in the traced cold-start context. The old 62-event $A020-$A6DB stream and FC payload boundaries are invalid.

opcode_notes.text_bytes: $00-$D7 are dispatched text tile IDs on the observed path, not Unicode. See live trace for frame and next-pointer observations.
opcode_notes.compact_pause: $D8-$DF inline waits map through ROM file 0x000AF6-0x000AFD to 1,10,20,40,60,80,120,240 frames.
opcode_notes.text_cursor_back: E0-E7 move the interpreter text cursor backward by opcode-E0 tile units.
opcode_notes.control: $E0-$E7 are inline cursor-back operations; $E8-$FF use bank-0 vectors. The observed trace records handler targets and pointer continuations, not complete handler semantics.
opcode_notes.jump: Withdrawn parse misclassified FE at $A29E. Live trace dispatches FE via $8862 and returns to script pointer $A020.
opcode_notes.input_wait: The former $A326 EB event was derived from withdrawn counted-FC parsing and is not verified by the live cold-start trace.
opcode_notes.timing_limit: Pause operand values are exact; conversion to Godot/visible NES frames and text/animation/PPU commit scheduling are not fully verified.
opcode_notes.visual_limit: Visual subroutines, palette/fade effects, portrait composition, and animation playback are exposed as source events/state for a renderer; not all raster semantics are reconstructed by this VM.
opcode_notes.dialog_line_control: FC is one byte on the observed cold-start path. Handler $8837 sets RAM $99=($99&$80)|$40, calls $9FA8 with A=$04, increments $51:$52 by $0040 and advances script pointer by one. The following byte is dispatched normally; full helper/visual meaning remains unresolved.
opcode_notes.pointer_aliasing: The 641-byte pointer span remains a lexical extract. The live trace verifies a FE loop at $A29E to $A020 and a later title handoff at $00E8; it does not establish a terminal stream boundary.
